item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02965","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correct expression 3,000 × 8 / 6 as 2,000 instead of 4,000.","case2_error":"Treats 675 / 150 batch counts as minutes, omitting the eight minutes required per batch.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correct expression; the second uses an incorrect time relation by omitting a required factor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02966","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 3,000 × 8 / 6 as 2,000 instead of 4,000.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 10 × 365 × 3 as 109,500 instead of 10,950, then propagates that error.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate correctly written expressions.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02967","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 13 after stating the correct average formula; the average is 9.","case2_error":"Counts only three face cards instead of twelve and three red cards per eligible rank instead of two.","reason":"The first supplies a wrong number without showing its calculation; the second explicitly miscounts the deck and favorable outcomes.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02968","case1_error":"Incorrectly rewrites 120 / 2 as 60 / 2 = 30, then gives unsupported final answer 15.","case2_error":"Uses half of a one-page reading time as the entire book's time, omitting the 100-page factor.","reason":"The first incorrectly evaluates a correct average expression; the second constructs an incorrect book-time relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02969","case1_error":"Uses the false conversion factor 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Adds the three-subject average to History instead of their sum to History, then gives 200 unsupported by that expression.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect unit conversion; the second substitutes an average for a subtotal and supplies an unsupported result.","judgment":"different"}]}
